plan.notes: Official 2026-2027 College of Western Idaho catalog, Biology AS Plan of Study Grid (official 4-term degree map). Catalog totals are published as "Minimum Credit Hours Required"; credit-range rows are recorded at the value implied by the catalog's own published term subtotals (documented per row). Term 1 GEM 4/GEM 3 option groups are ambiguous in the published subtotal (two combinations sum to 16); recorded with the standard-path combination CHEM 111 & 111L (4 cr) + 5-credit math, disclosed in row notes.

courses.title: General Chemistry I (with CHEM 111L)
courses.choice_note: Select one of the following options (GEM 4): CHEM 110 + CHEM 111P + CHEM 111L (6 cr) or CHEM 111 + CHEM 111L (4 cr). Published term subtotal (16) reflects the 4-credit option.

courses.title: Precalculus
courses.choice_note: Select one of the following courses (GEM 3): MATH 143 (3 cr), MATH 147 (5 cr), MATH 160 (4 cr), MATH 170 (5 cr) per the official CWI course catalog. Published term subtotal (16) reflects a 5-credit selection; recorded with the first 5-credit option (MATH 147). The 6-cr CHEM + 3-cr MATH combination also sums to 16 and cannot be ruled out from the published data.
